summary: Frontend-only testing of Chullz portrait oval poker table redesign. All 8 requested features fully verified with screenshots. The portrait oval layout (281x490, ratio 1.74, taller than wide) is working perfectly. All 3 community boards are stacked VERTICALLY INSIDE the green felt oval with correct card reveals per street. Player seats correctly positioned: BluffMaster at top, AceKing at bottom. Full game flow tested: PRE-FLOP → FLOP → TURN → RIVER → ASSIGNMENT.

react_native_issues.issue: shadow* style props deprecated warnings (shadow*, use boxShadow). Cosmetic only, no functional impact.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add testID attributes to poker-table.tsx interactive elements (back button, start game button, action buttons) to enable reliable automated testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified. Key measurements: Portrait oval is 281x490px (ratio 1.74). 3 boards have 15 xs-size cards inside the green felt (rgb(14,74,38)).
